Every program flagged verified=true while source="edvoy" (aggregator) and programUrl points to a generic Edvoy institution page, not a per-program official URL — false verification claim.
keyFactsRu states "65 программ / Программы: бакалавриат" (bachelor's) — propagates the false bachelor-level claim to user-facing copy.
Campus image uses generic stock placeholder /photos/_lib/campus-3.jpg rather than an actual LMC campus photo.
evidence: Official site losmedanos.edu confirmed: public community college, Pittsburg Campus (2700 East Leland Rd, Pittsburg CA 94565) plus Brentwood Center (1351 Pioneer Square, Brentwood CA). International Students page (losmedanos.edu/inted): offers Associate Degrees and Certificates of Achievement across most majors — NOT bachelor's degrees, confirming the catalog's level="bachelor" on all 65 programs is wrong. Program TITLES themselves (AS-T Computer Science, AA Recording Arts, CA Fire Technology, ADJ, Nursing, etc.) match real LMC offerings, so program list is substantively real but mislabeled => 'stale'. CAMPUSES: catalog lists only 'LMC Pittsburg Campus' (correct) but omits Brentwood Center and uses a stock photo => 'stale'.
